newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks in London depressed by Dow, FTSE.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks in London depressed by Dow, FTSE.

text.p: Hong Kong shares trading in London sank in thin trade on Friday as a weak FTSE and Dow depressed the market, dealers said.
"A weak London pulled us down and when the Street started lower we came down to the day's lows," one dealer said. "I don't think we'll see much chance of a recovery."
By 1517 GMT the Hang Seng London Reference Index was 45.68 points lower at 13,333.87. The FTSE 100 was off 41.7 points at 4,229.8 and the Dow was down 20.78 at 6,734.97.
Dealers said HSBC had once again been the centre of attention in the market.
"HSBC climbed to about HK$1.00 above its Hong Kong close although it's now come back to about HK$0.50 above," a dealer said.
Overnight, the Hang Seng in Hong Kong fell 230.78 points to 13,379.55 after Thursday's reversal on Wall Street.
"A lot of people were pretty shocked by the movements overnight and stayed out of trade in London," a dealer said.
